concepts.name: Shim
concepts.personality: A patient helper who makes the last tiny adjustment.
concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent PNG master of one original Lattices desktop companion, designed to remain clear at only 24 pixels inside a 32-pixel control. Lattices is a calm macOS window and desktop organiser; this little mover is deliberate, careful and born from a grid. Create ONE full-body character, no other objects or poses. Style: refined minimal editorial toy illustration, FLAT graphic fills with only one broad neutral-gray shaded plane to suggest tile thickness, no soft glossy rendering. Compact strong geometric silhouette, rounded but solid edges. A thick clean near-black #141416 perimeter about 1/24 of body width completely encloses the silhouette; perimeter has uniform confident width and smooth continuous edges. Absolutely clean continuous alpha contour. No white extraction crumbs, no stippling, no stray flecks, no mottling, no halos, no white fringe, no detached pixels. Interior off-white and green fills must stop neatly at the near-black outline. Exactly TWO large clearly separated near-black vertical pill eyes directly on the off-white material; each eye roughly one eighth of face width. NO mouth, nose, eyebrows, cheeks or tiny details. Palette: neutral off-white #f2f2f2, near-black #141416, neutral gray shading, and ONE accent color running green #33C773. No other colors. Square composition, centered character fills about 90 percent of the canvas, tight even transparent margins, no clipping. Genuinely transparent background and transparent empty space. No floor and no shadow outside the character. Avoid all text, writing, labels, logos, numbers, watermark, busy backgrounds, purple, violet, magenta, robot bodies, screen faces, ghosts, cats, bunnies, hats, accessories, glossy plastic, fine texture. This is an original companion, never a modified logo. Character-specific concept: SHIM is a stout beveled wedge tile creature with a very wide stable base and a gently sloped upper edge. Low squat trapezoidal silhouette, one broad green upper bevel running along the sloping top. Its two big dark pill eyes sit well apart on the broad off-white front. A solid one-piece body with two extremely short integrated broad feet separated by one simple underside notch. Near-frontal view with the slightest suggestion of depth. Friendly, patient, sure-footed, quietly precise. Do not make a triangular point; the top remains wide and substantial.

concepts.name: Ply
concepts.personality: The quiet sorter who keeps every layer in order.
concepts.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached Ply character master. Preserve the exact silhouette, proportions, two eye positions, neutral off-white material, green accent placement, and pose. CHANGE ONLY the alpha cutout quality: remove every stray white or green fleck and all disconnected pixels around the character. The outer contour and all internal gaps must have clean smooth anti-aliased edges against fully transparent empty pixels. No white halo, matte residue, texture, grain, or fringe. Every pixel outside the clean contour must be fully transparent alpha zero, including all corners. Keep soft broad interior shading but use clean graphic shape boundaries. Return a high-quality genuinely transparent square PNG. No floor, no external shadow, no background, no text, no purple/violet/magenta. Preserve the character centered with generous visible transparent margins and no clipping.
concepts.initialPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE original micro-character transparent PNG master for a calm macOS workspace organiser, displayed at 24 pixels inside a 32-pixel control. A small deliberate mover born from a window grid. Minimal refined tactile editorial toy, mostly flat graphic forms with subtle broad gray shading only, not a photorealistic product rendering. All structural parts are broad and solid. Exactly TWO LARGE clearly separated near-black vertical pill eyes directly on pale material; eyes at least 1/9 body width each. NO screen panel, mouth, nose, eyebrows, cheeks, eyelashes, or tiny details. Palette ONLY neutral off-white #f2f2f2, near-black #141416, neutral gray shading, and ONE accent green #33C773. Absolutely NO purple, violet, magenta, blue tint, or warm cream. Strong silhouette, restrained corners, quiet and competent. Square canvas, centered full-body character fills about 90 percent of canvas width, minimal even clear padding, no clipping. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND with alpha, transparent gaps; no floor, no external shadow, no scenery or props. No text, lettering, labels, watermark, logos, modified logo, contact sheet, extra pose, robot, screen face, ghost, cat, rabbit, or bunny. Character-specific concept: PLY is two CHUNKY offset horizontal rectangular slabs fused as ONE living tile, like two layers that agreed on a perfect offset. The upper slab is a very thick off-white rounded rectangle, bearing the two giant widely separated eyes. The lower slab is offset conspicuously to the right by one sixth of body width; it is broad and thick and has a small central rectangular notch at its lower edge to make two very short broad integral feet. One single GREEN exposed upper edge on the lower slab is a broad visible horizontal accent; all other faces are neutral off-white. No line between the eyes. The two-step asymmetrical exterior silhouette is essential. Slight three-quarter view with only a little visible top plane, almost frontal. No arms, no separate legs, no floating parts. Its personality is a quiet sorter who keeps every layer in order.
